name: coding_agent_shims
description: Install PATH shims in ~/.vrooli/bin so coding agents started from any shell carry a Vrooli identity. See package doc for why this replaced the bash-only shell functions.

shims.rationale: Alias links to vrooli-agent-launcher. Pinned because the directory must stay on PATH ahead of the agents' own install directories for the shims to be reached at all; moving it silently disables attribution. The contents are regenerable — the safeguard recreates every alias from the launcher binary.

budget.rationale: One symlink per supported agent on Unix; on Windows one copy of the launcher per agent. Five agents against a launcher of a few megabytes stays far inside this ceiling, and the ceiling makes an unbounded copy loop visible.

storage.rationale: The shims are host installation artifacts owned and rebuilt by this safeguard.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
